name: card_store

pipeline.tier_reason: the kernel section validates every card of the store against its type's schema, every load error and every reference: exhaustive over the store as loaded

statement: Everything is a card: registries of JSON cards in layers (model, self, project), a schema per card type, unknown fields kept, every write versioned, malformed and dangling cards reported.
usefulness: One place for everything the model knows, with history: an update never loses the old version, and fields another tool adds survive.
